pokedex.1: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.
pokedex.2: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower’s coming bloom.
pokedex.3: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.
pokedex.4: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.
pokedex.5: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.
pokedex.6: It is said that Charizard’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.
pokedex.7: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
pokedex.8: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.
pokedex.9: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.
pokedex.10: It releases a stench from its red antenna to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.
pokedex.11: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.
pokedex.12: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.
pokedex.13: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.
pokedex.14: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.
pokedex.15: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.
pokedex.16: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.
pokedex.17: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.
pokedex.18: By flapping its wings with all its might, Pidgeot can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.
pokedex.19: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.
pokedex.20: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.
pokedex.21: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.
pokedex.22: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.
pokedex.23: It sneaks through grass without making a sound and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.
pokedex.24: The pattern on its belly is for intimidation. It constricts foes while they are frozen in fear.
pokedex.25: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.
pokedex.26: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.
pokedex.27: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.
pokedex.28: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.
pokedex.29: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.
pokedex.30: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than Nidorino’s.
pokedex.31: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.
pokedex.32: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.
pokedex.33: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.
pokedex.34: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.
pokedex.35: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.
pokedex.36: It is very wary and rarely shows itself to people. Its ears can hear a pin drop over half a mile away.
pokedex.37: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.
pokedex.38: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.
pokedex.39: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.
pokedex.40: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.
pokedex.41: It checks its surroundings and location using reflections of the ultrasonic waves from its mouth.
pokedex.42: Its sharp fangs puncture the toughest of hides and have small holes for greedily sucking blood.
pokedex.43: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.
pokedex.44: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.
pokedex.45: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.
pokedex.46: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host Paras.
pokedex.47: A mushroom grown larger than the host’s body controls Parasect. It scatters poisonous spores.
pokedex.48: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
pokedex.49: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.
pokedex.50: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.
pokedex.51: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.
pokedex.52: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.
pokedex.53: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.
pokedex.54: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.
pokedex.55: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.
pokedex.56: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.
pokedex.57: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.
pokedex.58: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.
pokedex.59: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.
pokedex.60: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.
pokedex.61: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.
pokedex.62: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.
pokedex.63: Using its psychic power is such a strain on its brain that it needs to sleep for 18 hours a day.
pokedex.64: It stares at its silver spoon to focus its mind. It emits more alpha waves while doing so.
pokedex.65: The spoons clutched in its hands are said to have been created by its psychic powers.
pokedex.66: Though small in stature, it is powerful enough to easily heft and throw a number of Geodude at once.
pokedex.67: It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.
pokedex.68: Its four muscled arms slam foes with powerful punches and chops at blinding speed.
pokedex.69: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.
pokedex.70: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.
pokedex.71: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honeylike scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.
pokedex.72: Because its body is almost entirely composed of water, it shrivels up if it is washed ashore.
pokedex.73: It extends its 80 tentacles to form an encircling poisonous net that is difficult to escape.
pokedex.74: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.
pokedex.75: It rolls on mountain paths to move. Once it builds momentum, no Pokémon can stop it without difficulty.
pokedex.76: Even dynamite can’t harm its hard, boulderlike body. It sheds its hide just once a year.
pokedex.77: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.
pokedex.78: When at an all-out gallop, its blazing mane sparkles, enhancing its beautiful appearance.
pokedex.79: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.
pokedex.80: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the Shellder on its tail bites down.
pokedex.81: The faster the units at its sides rotate, the greater the magnetic force they generate.
pokedex.82: Many mysteriously appear when more sunspots dot the sun. They stop TV sets from displaying properly.
pokedex.83: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.
pokedex.84: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.
pokedex.85: When Doduo evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.
pokedex.86: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.
pokedex.87: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.
pokedex.88: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.
pokedex.89: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.
pokedex.90: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.
pokedex.91: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.
pokedex.92: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.
pokedex.93: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.
pokedex.94: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a Gengar delighting in casting curses on people.
pokedex.95: It burrows through the ground at a speed of 50 mph while feeding on large boulders.
pokedex.96: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.
pokedex.97: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.
pokedex.98: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.
pokedex.99: The larger pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.
pokedex.100: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.
pokedex.101: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.
pokedex.102: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.
pokedex.103: It is called “The Walking Jungle.” If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.
pokedex.104: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.
pokedex.105: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.
pokedex.106: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.
pokedex.107: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
pokedex.108: When it extends its over-six-foot- long tongue, its tail quivers. There is a possibility they are connected.
pokedex.109: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.
pokedex.110: It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found.
pokedex.111: Its powerful tackles can destroy anything. However, it is too slow witted to help people work.
pokedex.112: Standing on its hind legs freed its forelegs and made it smarter. It is very forgetful, however.
pokedex.113: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.
pokedex.114: The blue vines shrouding its body are covered in a growth of fine hair. It is known to be ticklish.
pokedex.115: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.
pokedex.116: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.
pokedex.117: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.
pokedex.118: Though it appears very elegant when swimming with fins unfurled, it can jab powerfully with its horn.
pokedex.119: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.
pokedex.120: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.
pokedex.121: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.
pokedex.122: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.
pokedex.123: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.
pokedex.124: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.
pokedex.125: It windmills its arms to slightly boost its punches. Foes have been known to escape in the meantime.
pokedex.126: When it breathes deeply, heat waves form around its body, making it hard to see clearly.
pokedex.127: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can’t tear, it tosses far.
pokedex.128: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.
pokedex.129: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.
pokedex.130: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.
pokedex.131: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.
pokedex.132: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.
pokedex.133: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.
pokedex.134: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can melt away into water.
pokedex.135: If agitated, it uses electricity to straighten out its fur and launch it in small bunches.
pokedex.136: Inhaled air is heated in the flame sac in its body to an intense fire over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokedex.137: A man-made Pokémon created using advanced scientific means. It can move freely in cyberspace.
pokedex.138: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.
pokedex.139: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.
pokedex.140: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.
pokedex.141: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.
pokedex.142: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.
pokedex.143: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.
pokedex.144: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.
pokedex.145: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.
pokedex.146: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.
pokedex.147: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.
pokedex.148: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.
pokedex.149: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.
pokedex.150: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew’s genes. It’s said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.
pokedex.151: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.
pokedex.152: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.
pokedex.153: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.
pokedex.154: Its breath has the fantastic ability to revive dead plants and flowers.
pokedex.155: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.
pokedex.156: It intimidates foes with the heat of its flames. The fire burns more strongly when it readies to fight.
pokedex.157: It attacks using blasts of fire. It creates heat shimmers with intense fire to hide itself.
pokedex.158: It has the habit of biting anything with its developed jaws. Even its Trainer needs to be careful.
pokedex.159: Once it bites down, it won’t let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.
pokedex.160: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.
pokedex.161: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.
pokedex.162: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.
pokedex.163: It marks time precisely. Some countries consider it to be a wise friend, versed in the world’s ways.
pokedex.164: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.
pokedex.165: It is so timid, it can’t move if it isn’t with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.
pokedex.166: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.
pokedex.167: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.
pokedex.168: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.
pokedex.169: The transformation of its legs into wings made it better at flying, but more clumsy at walking.
pokedex.170: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.
pokedex.171: Lanturn’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”
pokedex.172: The electric sacs in its cheeks are small. If even a little electricity leaks, it becomes shocked.
pokedex.173: It is often seen when shooting stars fill the night skies. It’s said to arrive riding on a shooting star.
pokedex.174: It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.
pokedex.175: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.
pokedex.176: To share its happiness, it flies around the world seeking kind- hearted people.
pokedex.177: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.
pokedex.178: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.
pokedex.179: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.
pokedex.180: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.
pokedex.181: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail’s light.
pokedex.182: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.
pokedex.183: The oil-filled end of its tail floats on water. It keeps Marill from drowning even in a strong current.
pokedex.184: It can spend all day in water, since it can inhale and store a large volume of air.
pokedex.185: To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.
pokedex.186: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make Poliwag obey.
pokedex.187: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.
pokedex.188: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.
pokedex.189: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.
pokedex.190: It lives high among the treetops. It can use its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.
pokedex.191: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. A year after a cold summer, their population explodes.
pokedex.192: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.
pokedex.193: It can hover in one spot by flapping its wings at high speed. It flits about to guard its territory.
pokedex.194: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.
pokedex.195: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.
pokedex.196: Its fur is so sensitive, it can sense minute shifts in the air and predict the weather.
pokedex.197: When exposed to the moon’s aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.
pokedex.198: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.
pokedex.199: Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.
pokedex.200: A Pokémon that startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.
pokedex.201: When alone, nothing happens. However, if there are two or more, an odd power is said to emerge.
pokedex.202: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.
pokedex.203: The head on its tail contains a small brain. It can instinctively fight even while facing backward.
pokedex.204: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.
pokedex.205: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.
pokedex.206: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.
pokedex.207: It glides as if sliding. It startles foes by clamping on to their faces, then jabs with its poison stinger.
pokedex.208: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.
pokedex.209: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.
pokedex.210: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.
pokedex.211: It shoots the poison spines on its body in all directions. Its round form makes it a poor swimmer.
pokedex.212: It raises its pincers with eyelike markings for intimidation. It also swings them down dangerously.
pokedex.213: It stores berries in its shell. The berries eventually ferment to become delicious juices.
pokedex.214: It loves sweet honey. To keep all the honey to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.
pokedex.215: A smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.
pokedex.216: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.
pokedex.217: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.
pokedex.218: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn’t keep moving, its body will cool and harden.
pokedex.219: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.
pokedex.220: It has a very sensitive nose. It can locate mushrooms, berries, and even hot springs buried under ice.
pokedex.221: Covered by a shaggy coat, it is strong against the cold. Its tusks of ice thicken when it snows.
pokedex.222: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.
pokedex.223: It forcefully squirts water. The water jet never misses prey even if the Remoraid is deep in the sea.
pokedex.224: It loves to lurk inside holes in rocks. It sometimes sprays ink on prey by sticking out only its mouth.
pokedex.225: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.
pokedex.226: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores Remoraid that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.
pokedex.227: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.
pokedex.228: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.
pokedex.229: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.
pokedex.230: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.
pokedex.231: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.
pokedex.232: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.
pokedex.233: It was upgraded to enable the exploration of other planets. However, it failed to measure up.
pokedex.234: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.
pokedex.235: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.
pokedex.236: It is famous for its eagerness to fight and always nurses injuries from challenging larger foes.
pokedex.237: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by ten.
pokedex.238: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.
pokedex.239: A weak electric current flows between its horns. Sticking a hand there shocks the unwary.
pokedex.240: Its magma-like blood circulates throughout its body. Its body’s heat can top 1,100 degrees F.
pokedex.241: It is said that kids who drink Miltank’s milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.
pokedex.242: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.
pokedex.243: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.
pokedex.244: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.
pokedex.245: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.
pokedex.246: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.
pokedex.247: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.
pokedex.248: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.
pokedex.249: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.
pokedex.250: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.
pokedex.251: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.
pokedex.252: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.
pokedex.253: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.
pokedex.254: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
pokedex.255: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.
pokedex.256: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.
pokedex.257: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.
pokedex.258: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.
pokedex.259: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
pokedex.260: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.
pokedex.261: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
pokedex.262: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.
pokedex.263: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.
pokedex.264: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.
pokedex.265: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.
pokedex.266: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.
pokedex.267: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.
pokedex.268: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.
pokedex.269: Toxic powder is scattered with each flap. At night, it is known to strip leaves off trees lining boulevards.
pokedex.270: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can’t swim.
pokedex.271: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.
pokedex.272: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.
pokedex.273: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.
pokedex.274: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.
pokedex.275: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.
pokedex.276: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

pokedex.546: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.
pokedex.547: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.
pokedex.548: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
pokedex.549: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.
pokedex.550: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.
pokedex.551: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.
pokedex.552: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
pokedex.553: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.
pokedex.554: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.
pokedex.555: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
pokedex.556: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
pokedex.557: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.
pokedex.558: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.
pokedex.559: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
pokedex.560: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.
pokedex.561: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.
pokedex.562: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.
pokedex.563: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
pokedex.564: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.
pokedex.565: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.
pokedex.566: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.
pokedex.567: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.
pokedex.568: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.
pokedex.569: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.
pokedex.570: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.
pokedex.571: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.
pokedex.572: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.
pokedex.573: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.
pokedex.574: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
pokedex.575: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.
pokedex.576: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
pokedex.577: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.
pokedex.578: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
pokedex.579: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.
pokedex.580: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.
pokedex.581: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
pokedex.582: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.
pokedex.583: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon’s habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.
pokedex.584: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.
pokedex.585: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.
pokedex.586: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.
pokedex.587: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.
pokedex.588: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
pokedex.589: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.
pokedex.590: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
pokedex.591: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.
pokedex.592: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.
pokedex.593: The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent’s habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.
pokedex.594: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.
pokedex.595: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.
pokedex.596: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.
pokedex.597: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.
pokedex.598: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.
pokedex.599: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.
pokedex.600: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.
pokedex.601: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.
pokedex.602: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
pokedex.603: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.
pokedex.604: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
pokedex.605: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.
pokedex.606: It can manipulate an opponent’s memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.
pokedex.607: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.
pokedex.608: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.
pokedex.609: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.
pokedex.610: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.
pokedex.611: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they’ve been fighting.
pokedex.612: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.
pokedex.613: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.
pokedex.614: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.
pokedex.615: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.
pokedex.616: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.
pokedex.617: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.
pokedex.618: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.
pokedex.619: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.
pokedex.620: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.
pokedex.621: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.
pokedex.622: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
pokedex.623: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.
pokedex.624: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.
pokedex.625: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.
pokedex.626: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
pokedex.627: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.
pokedex.628: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.
pokedex.629: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.
pokedex.630: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.
pokedex.631: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.
pokedex.632: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.
pokedex.633: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.
pokedex.634: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.
pokedex.635: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.
pokedex.636: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.
pokedex.637: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.
pokedex.638: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.
pokedex.639: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.
pokedex.640: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.
pokedex.641: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.
pokedex.642: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.
pokedex.643: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.
pokedex.644: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.
pokedex.645: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”
pokedex.646: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.
pokedex.647: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.
pokedex.648: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
pokedex.649: Over 300 million years ago, it was feared as the strongest of hunters. It has been modified by Team Plasma.

moves.pound: The target is physically pounded with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.
moves.scratch: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.
moves.teleport: Use it to flee from any wild Pokémon. It can also warp to the last Pokémon Center visited.
moves.night-shade: The user makes the target see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage matching the user’s level.
moves.mimic: The user copies the target’s last move. The move can be used during battle until the Pokémon is switched out.
moves.screech: An earsplitting screech harshly reduces the target’s Defense stat.
moves.double-team: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.
moves.recover: Restoring its own cells, the user restores its own HP by half of its max HP.
moves.harden: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.
moves.minimize: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply raises its evasiveness.
moves.smokescreen: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. It reduces the target’s accuracy.
moves.confuse-ray: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.
moves.vice-grip: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.
moves.withdraw: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.
moves.defense-curl: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.
moves.barrier: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.
moves.light-screen: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.
moves.haze: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.
moves.reflect: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.
moves.focus-energy: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.
moves.bide: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.
moves.metronome: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.
moves.mirror-move: The user counters the target by mimicking the target’s last move.
moves.guillotine: A vicious, tearing attack with big pincers. The target will faint instantly if this attack hits.
moves.self-destruct: The user attacks everything around it by causing an explosion. The user faints upon using this move.
moves.egg-bomb: A large egg is hurled at the target with maximum force to inflict damage.
moves.lick: The target is licked with a long tongue, causing damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.smog: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. It may also poison the target.
moves.sludge: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.
moves.bone-club: The user clubs the target with a bone. It may also make the target flinch.
moves.fire-blast: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.waterfall: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.
moves.clamp: The target is clamped and squeezed by the user’s very thick and sturdy shell for four to five turns.
moves.swift: Star-shaped rays are shot at the opposing team. This attack never misses.
moves.razor-wind: A two-turn attack. Blades of wind hit opposing Pokémon on the second turn. Critical hits land more easily.
moves.skull-bash: The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense in the first turn, then rams the target on the next turn.
moves.spike-cannon: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.
moves.constrict: The target is attacked with long, creeping tentacles or vines. It may also lower the target’s Speed stat.
moves.amnesia: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.
moves.kinesis: The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. It lowers the target’s accuracy.
moves.soft-boiled: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.
moves.high-jump-kick: The target is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If it misses, the user is hurt instead.
moves.glare: The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.
moves.dream-eater: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user’s HP.
moves.poison-gas: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the face of opposing Pokémon. It may poison those hit.
moves.swords-dance: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.
moves.barrage: Round objects are hurled at the target to strike two to five times in a row.
moves.leech-life: The user drains the target’s blood. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
moves.lovely-kiss: With a scary face, the user tries to force a kiss on the target. If it succeeds, the target falls asleep.
moves.sky-attack: A second-turn attack move where critical hits land more easily. It may also make the target flinch.
moves.transform: The user transforms into a copy of the target right down to having the same move set.
moves.bubble: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the opposing team. It may also lower the targets’ Speed stats.
moves.dizzy-punch: The target is hit with rhythmically launched punches that may also leave it confused.
moves.spore: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.
moves.flash: The user flashes a bright light that cuts the target’s accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.
moves.psywave: The target is attacked with an odd psychic wave. The attack varies in intensity.
moves.cut: The target is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.
moves.splash: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...
moves.acid-armor: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply raising its Defense stat.
moves.crabhammer: The target is hammered with a large pincer. Critical hits land more easily.
moves.explosion: The user explodes to inflict damage on those around it. The user faints upon using this move.
moves.fury-swipes: The target is raked with sharp claws or scythes for two to five times in quick succession.
moves.bonemerang: The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops to hit the target twice, coming and going.
moves.rest: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.
moves.rock-slide: Large boulders are hurled at the opposing team to inflict damage. It may also make the targets flinch.
moves.hyper-fang: The user bites hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. It may also make the target flinch.
moves.sharpen: The user reduces its polygon count to make itself more jagged, raising the Attack stat.
moves.gust: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.
moves.conversion: The user changes its type to become the same type as one of its moves.
moves.tri-attack: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. May also burn, freeze, or leave the target with paralysis.
moves.super-fang: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. It cuts the target’s HP to half.
moves.slash: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. Critical hits land more easily.
moves.substitute: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.
moves.sketch: It enables the user to permanently learn the move last used by the target. Once used, Sketch disappears.
moves.triple-kick: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successive hit.
moves.thief: The user attacks and steals the target’s held item simultaneously. It can’t steal if the user holds an item.
moves.spider-web: The user ensnares the target with thin, gooey silk so it can’t flee from battle.
moves.wing-attack: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.
moves.mind-reader: The user senses the target’s movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss the target.
moves.nightmare: A sleeping target sees a nightmare that inflicts some damage every turn.
moves.flame-wheel: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. It may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.snore: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.
moves.curse: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all other types.
moves.flail: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. It becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
moves.conversion-2: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the attack the opponent used last.
moves.aeroblast: A vortex of air is shot at the target to inflict damage. Critical hits land more easily.
moves.cotton-spore: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to the target, harshly reducing its Speed stat.
moves.reversal: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
moves.whirlwind: The target is blown away, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.
moves.spite: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.
moves.powder-snow: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. It may also freeze the targets.
moves.protect: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
moves.mach-punch: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. It is certain to strike first.
moves.scary-face: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly reduce its Speed stat.
moves.feint-attack: The user approaches the target disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. It hits without fail.
moves.sweet-kiss: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.
moves.belly-drum: The user maximizes its Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.
moves.sludge-bomb: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.
moves.mud-slap: The user hurls mud in the target’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.
moves.fly: The user soars, then strikes its target on the second turn. It can also be used for flying to any familiar town.
moves.octazooka: The user attacks by spraying ink in the target’s face or eyes. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.
moves.spikes: The user lays a trap of spikes at the opposing team’s feet. The trap hurts Pokémon that switch into battle.
moves.zap-cannon: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and cause paralysis.
moves.foresight: Enables a Ghost-type target to be hit by Normal- and Fighting-type attacks. It also enables an evasive target to be hit.
moves.destiny-bond: When this move is used, if the user faints, the Pokémon that landed the knockout hit also faints.
moves.perish-song: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.
moves.icy-wind: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. It also reduces the targets’ Speed stat.
moves.detect: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
moves.bone-rush: The user strikes the target with a hard bone two to five times in a row.
moves.lock-on: The user takes sure aim at the target. It ensures the next attack does not fail to hit the target.
moves.karate-chop: The target is attacked with a sharp chop. Critical hits land more easily.
moves.bind: Things such as long bodies or tentacles are used to bind and squeeze the target for four to five turns.
moves.outrage: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.
moves.sandstorm: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types.
moves.giga-drain: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
moves.endure: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
moves.charm: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. The target’s Attack is harshly lowered.
moves.rollout: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.
moves.false-swipe: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.
moves.swagger: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, it also sharply raises the target’s Attack stat.
moves.milk-drink: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.
moves.spark: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.slam: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, etc., to inflict damage.
moves.fury-cutter: The target is slashed with scythes or claws. Its power increases if it hits in succession.
moves.steel-wing: The target is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user’s Defense stat.
moves.mean-look: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.
moves.attract: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.
moves.sleep-talk: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.
moves.heal-bell: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status problems of all the party Pokémon.
moves.return: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.
moves.present: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. It restores HP sometimes, however.
moves.frustration: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.
moves.safeguard: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.
moves.vine-whip: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.
moves.pain-split: The user adds its HP to the target’s HP, then equally shares the combined HP with the target.
moves.sacred-fire: The target is razed with a mystical fire of great intensity. It may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.magnitude: The user looses a ground-shaking quake affecting everyone around the user. Its power varies.
moves.dynamic-punch: The user punches the target with full, concentrated power. It confuses the target if it hits.
moves.megahorn: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.
moves.dragon-breath: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.baton-pass: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, passing along any stat changes.
moves.encore: The user compels the target to keep using only the move it last used for three turns.
moves.pursuit: An attack move that inflicts double damage if used on a target that is switching out of battle.
moves.rapid-spin: A spin attack that can also eliminate such moves as Bind, Wrap, Leech Seed, and Spikes.
moves.stomp: The target is stomped with a big foot. It may also make the target flinch.
moves.sweet-scent: A sweet scent that lowers the opposing team’s evasiveness. It also lures wild Pokémon if used in grass, etc.
moves.iron-tail: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.
moves.metal-claw: The target is raked with steel claws. It may also raise the user’s Attack stat.
moves.vital-throw: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move is guaranteed not to miss.
moves.morning-sun: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
moves.synthesis: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
moves.moonlight: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
moves.hidden-power: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.
moves.cross-chop: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. Critical hits land more easily.
moves.twister: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at the opposing team. It may also make targets flinch.
moves.double-kick: The target is quickly kicked twice in succession using both feet.
moves.rain-dance: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves.
moves.sunny-day: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.
moves.crunch: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.
moves.mirror-coat: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage taken.
moves.psych-up: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.
moves.extreme-speed: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This attack always goes before any other move.
moves.ancient-power: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.
moves.shadow-ball: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.
moves.future-sight: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.
moves.rock-smash: The user attacks with a punch that can shatter a rock. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.
moves.mega-kick: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.
moves.whirlpool: Traps foes in a violent swirling whirlpool for four to five turns.
moves.beat-up: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.
